scope: Independent report-only critique of Research-OS orchestration, lane overlap, selection leakage, stale-state/race risks, provenance boundaries, and AI/agent evidence separation.
prompt: Review the supplied repository context as an independent adversarial methods reviewer. Identify concrete risks that could make autonomous research less reproducible or accidentally introduce selection, look-ahead, duplicate-work, stale-state, or provenance leakage. Focus on the orchestration layer, not trading strategy selection. Preserve disagreement and uncertainty. For every finding, state the mechanism, why it matters, and a cheap deterministic falsification or engineering check. Do not perform backtests, rank candidates, select assets/parameters/thresholds/horizons, alter gates, or claim scientific evidence. End with a compact engineering handoff.
